_: THE RECORD OF STANDING — the one place the College's own figures live.
Every page that states what the College has done reads from this file.
Nothing is typed twice, so nothing can drift: the Arabic edition and
the English edition cannot disagree, and a figure corrected here is
corrected on every page in both languages by re-running the build.
WHERE THESE FIGURES COME FROM. They are the College's own enrolment
and assessment record, attested by the Principal on 18 August 2026 and
recorded in `attested` below. A college's own registry is the primary
source for its own enrolment — no external body counts students on its
behalf — and the attestation is held here so that the date and the
authority behind each figure are part of the record rather than
remembered.
THE RULE THAT MAKES IT SAFE. A count left null is not a zero. It means
the College holds the record but has not released that figure for
publication; the build then emits the unnumbered wording in `prose`,
and tests/published-claims.test.mjs fails the build if a numeral
appears in copy this file has not supplied. A figure cannot reach the
site by being typed confidently into a paragraph.
TO CHANGE A FIGURE: edit it here, move `attested.on` to the date it
was checked against the registry, and run `node scripts/build.js`.

_: The chronology that resolves what would otherwise be a contradiction.
The College taught and conferred from 2023 under its own academic
authority. The governance instrument adopted on 14 August 2026 created
the office of Independent External Examiner and bound every award made
under it to that office's moderation. Awards conferred before that
date were moderated inside the College; the instrument binds awards
from its adoption forward. Both statements are true at once, and the
site says which is which rather than choosing one.
